findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 4
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - dismissing a form while its submission is awaiting a response.
The `!form.formState.isSubmitting` condition bypasses confirmation during submission and calls `close()`, which immediately resets the typed text. If the request fails, the dialog has already closed and its input is gone. This affects both invite-dialog.tsx:48 and add-agent-dialog.tsx:43. Keep dirty input protected until submission succeeds; the success handlers already call `close()` directly. The browser test only dismisses forms before submission, so it misses this path.
